🔧 Construction Notes

Wall Extension Work

  • Extension required: 237mm toward front (increases depth from ~1005mm to 1242mm)
  • Method: Remove existing plasterboard ~200mm back from end, expose studs
  • Construction: Extend metal stud frame forward by 237mm
  • Finish: Apply new plasterboard over extended frame for clean join
  • Result: Full 1242mm depth alcove for cabin bed

Metal Stud Frame (70mm system)

  • Vertical studs at 400mm centers
  • Horizontal noggins at 530mm (platform), 975mm (tablet), 1200mm (shelf)
  • Rear wall frame stops at 1200mm; front/side frames continue to 2380mm
  • 12.5mm plasterboard on visible faces

Electrical Safety (Timber Floor)

  • Floor: Timber joists with thin board, cables running below
  • Max screw penetration: 25-30mm only
  • Primary fixing: Grab adhesive recommended
  • Before drilling: Always use cable detector

Support Structure

  • Bed support legs: 6 total (20mm × 20mm timber)
  • 4 corner legs + 2 middle legs at 940mm from left edge
  • Drawer runners: Floor-mounted, 20mm clearance below, 10mm above
  • Platform: 173mm base height + 357mm frame = 530mm total

💡 Lighting & ESP32 Integration

7" ESP32 Touchscreen

  • Location: Rear shelf center, at 975mm height (between mattress top 750mm and shelf 1200mm)
  • Mounting: Flush-mounted, requires noggin support at ~975mm
  • Function: Music control for corner speaker

Three Lighting Systems

1. Ambient Lighting (Warm & Cosy)

  • WS2812B addressable LED strips under rear shelf and head wall shelf
  • Warm white 2700-3000K with optional RGB mood settings
  • ESP32 + WLED firmware for patterns and dimming

2. Reading Light (Neutral White)

  • Dimmable LED strip at head wall or rear shelf underside
  • 4000K neutral white, CRI >90 for comfortable reading
  • PWM dimming via ESP32

3. Starfield Projection (4 Options)

Option A - Fiber Optic (Most Realistic):

  • 200-400 fiber strands through black fabric/board on ceiling area
  • RGB LED light engine controlled by ESP32
  • Random strand lengths create depth and twinkling

Option B - WS2812B Individual Stars:

  • 50-100 addressable LEDs on ceiling/walls
  • Independent control per "star" via WLED
  • Programmable patterns (twinkling, shooting stars, constellations)

Option C - Sky Projector:

  • LED/laser projector with ESP32-controlled rotation motor
  • Projects realistic nebula/star patterns
  • Can combine with fiber optics for layered effect

Option D - Hybrid (Fiber + LEDs):

  • 100 fiber optic strands for background stars
  • 20-30 WS2812B LEDs for planets and prominent stars
  • Best balance of realism and programmability
